selection: Each new fit selects and early-stops on its target validation standardized MSE only.
protocol: Eleven target-focused plain MLPs, each with 90% target / 1% per auxiliary loss. Uniform and 100%-target controls share all eleven heads, initialization, balanced batches and settings. One shared best checkpoint per fit; full encoder fine-tuning; no new task attention. Five seeds on the frozen complete-IL split. Prespecified 200-epoch cap for all new arms, patience 15. Historical 100-epoch single-task and all-task-selected MTL are contextual references. Tabular primary comparator: lowest five-seed validation standardized MSE across all six configurations. Lowest historical five-seed test MAE is a separate descriptive benchmark, never a deployment nomination. No best-seed selection. Native CO2 MAE, ln-viscosity MAE; preserve both target spaces. Previously inspected test split: exploratory comparison, not independent confirmation.
